quests.prompt: [Calibration Dispatch 161-1] Draft an official mission brief describing the discovery of thermal chimney fields in the Mariana Trench.
options: WE HAVE SUCCESSFULLY DOCUMENTED ACTIVE HYDROTHERMAL CHIMNEYS VENTING SUPERHEATED CHEMICAL PLUMES.
